Last chance to register to vote or make changes before Election Day (November 3, 2026) 
			October 14, 2026 
The Supervisors of the Checklist will be in session on Saturday, October 24, 2026 from 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM at the Town Offices located at 661 Turnpike Road. This is the  LAST  day to register to vote or make changes to the checklist before Election Day, November 3, 2026. 
Registering to Vote 
If you are unsure of requirements for voting registration, please refer to the  State of New Hampshire’s website  for more detail.  
Those who are unable to make this session, can still register to vote via the Town Clerk. The Town Clerk’s office maintains the following hours: 
Monday - Wednesday: 9:00AM - 4:00PM 
Thursday: 9:00AM - 6:00PM 
Typically last Saturday of every month (9:00AM - 12:00PM) 
October 31, 2026 
*Note - The office is closed to the public from 12:30PM - 1:30PM for lunch each day. Hours may be impacted by holidays. If the hours fall on or around a major holiday, these changes will be updated on the town calendar, located at the bottom of the website’s  home page . 
Sample Ballot 
Voters wondering what to expect on this November’s ballot are encouraged to refer to the  sample ballot . 
Additional Resources 
Those interested in additional election resources may refer to the State of New Hampshire’s  website  and to this  voter guide , provided by the New Hampshire Secretary of State.
